## TRA Timeline

#### Contemplated SPAC business combination

- 2021-09-08: HTP enters into Agreement and Plan of Merger with Packable Holdings, LLC for an Up-C de-SPAC; form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the BCA-announcement 8-K
- 2021-10-22: First Amendment to Merger Agreement attaches revised form-of TRA reflecting revised post-Closing governance; substantive terms unchanged

#### Termination of the business combination

- 2022-03-25: HTP and Packable mutually agree to terminate the Business Combination Agreement citing unfavorable market conditions; no TRA was ever executed

## Explanation

Highland Transcend Partners I was a SPAC that signed a Business Combination Agreement with Packable Holdings, LLC on September 8, 2021 contemplating an Up-C de-SPAC under which the surviving public company (to be renamed Packable Commerce, Inc.) would have executed a Tax Receivable Agreement paying 85% of the cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups (on exchanges of Packable Holdings LLC Units), Pre-IPO Tax Assets, and imputed interest to Packable's pre-Closing equity holders. The October 22, 2021 First Amendment to the Merger Agreement attached a revised form-of TRA reflecting a revised post-Closing governance structure; substantive economics were unchanged. The Business Combination Agreement was terminated on March 25, 2022 before close; HTP remained a shell SPAC and Packable subsequently filed for bankruptcy outside this directory's scope. No executed TRA exists. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
